Ghent Region | Leadership experience | GMP & cleanroom | Shift system | 1110509

About the organization 
Our client is an international manufacturing company active in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector. From their site in Flanders, they produce innovative therapies that improve patients' lives worldwide. The organization is known for its high-tech environment, strong growth, and a culture where collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement are key.

Your new role
As a Production Supervisor, you are the heartbeat of a GMP manufacturing environment. You lead operational teams and ensure that all processes meet the highest standards of quality and safety.

Your responsibilities include:

• Leadership and coaching: Motivate and guide production teams in a cleanroom environment.
• Compliance and audits: Ensure adherence to cGMP standards and act as a key contact during inspections.
• Documentation management: Oversee procedures, batch records, and ensure timely release.
• Process improvement: Initiate projects to enhance efficiency, quality, and safety.
• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with QA, QC, Engineering, and Supply Chain.
• Training: Ensure your team is well-trained and foster a culture of ownership and learning.
You will report directly to the Operations Manager.

 

What we expect from you

• Bachelor or Master degree in science, bioengineering, pharmacy, or equivalent through experience
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or pharma
• Knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations
• Strong communication and organizational skills
• Proficiency in MS Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus
• Fluent in English (Dutch is an asset)

Ghent region | bachelor in Lab or Biotechnology | GMP, cleanroom, LIMS | Quality Control | 1110364
About the organization
Our client in the Ghent region is an international company with a production site where highly regulated processes are carried out. The environment is modern, structured and safety‑focused. You will join a team where quality, collaboration and precision are key.

 

Your new role
As a Lab Technician, you will perform quality control on advanced therapies in a GMP environment. You will take samples, carry out analyses (including flow cytometry and glucose testing), and monitor the cleanroom environment (ISO 5). You will work closely with Quality and Operations, manage test results in LIMS, and contribute to optimizing processes and documentation.

 
 

What do we expect from you?

• Bachelor's degree in lab technology, biotechnology or equivalent
• Knowledge of GMP and quality standards (FDA/EU)
• Experience with aseptic techniques or cleanrooms is a plus
• Strong communication skills in Dutch and technical English
• Accurate, well-organized and a true team player

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) - Antwerp.

Our client is an innovative organization with a long-term vision and a strong commitment to sustainable value creation. You will join a collaborative finance environment where strategy, finance and entrepreneurship come together in support of lasting growth.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) include:

• You support the day-to-day accounting activities across multiple group entities and help ensure financial records are accurate, complete and up to date.
• You process invoices, bank transactions and journal entries, and contribute to the monthly, quarterly and annual closing processes.
• You assist in monitoring balance sheet accounts and help maintain a high level of financial accuracy and compliance.
• You contribute to the preparation of periodic financial reports for internal and external stakeholders.
• You support the preparation of statutory financial statements, audit documentation, reconciliations and balance sheet analyses.
• You help optimize and standardize accounting and financial processes within an evolving finance organization.
• You support the implementation of internal controls and accounting policies to strengthen the control environment and improve efficiency.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in accountancy, Finance or a related field, combined with around three years of relevant professional experience.

• You have experience with SAP or another ERP system, which is considered a strong asset.
• You have a basic knowledge of IFRS, which is an advantage.
• You have an interest in or experience with real estate and/or private equity structures.
• You are analytical, accurate, proactive and eager to learn.
• You work well in a team and communicate smoothly with colleagues.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

This requires a deep understanding of our solutions and the ability to solve technical puzzles. You will take full ownership of client questions ensuring that users receive the right advice, can use the product effectively and have their issues resolved quickly and efficiently. As you master our platform and understand the different configurations of our clients, this role offers a clear growth path towards an implementation consultant or customer success account management role.
 

How you'll make an impact

• Adapt and adjust existing custom configurations tailored to the needs of our clients. 

• Create and maintain 
customer-facing support documentation and tutorial videos. 

• Thoroughly reproduce, verify and analyze reported bugs, resolving what you can and 
accurately translating issues for the product team. 

• Own the end-to-end communication for client issues, ensuring the user stays informed and guided even when an issue is escalated. 

• Build a deep 
understanding of each client’s specific setup to provide proactive support. 

• Collaborate closely with internal teams (product team, Information Security team) to ensure timely and high-quality support. 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent experience in a similar role. 

• A customer-centric professional with 
excellent communication skills who genuinely enjoys helping experts solve complex problems. 

• Fluency in 
English ( 
spoken and written) is an absolute must. 

• Ability to translate business needs or functional problems into 
clear technical requirements. 

• A 
strong analytical mindset. You don’t just pass along an issue, you investigate the root cause and resolve the issue yourself or introduce short-term workarounds to unblock the client. 

• A strong affinity for 
complex enterprise SaaS software solutions combined with the eagerness to learn about MRM and AI governance.

Adecco is looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Officer to strengthen the Volvo Action Service team at Volvo Group! 

Help drivers get back on the road quickly and efficiently. As a Breakdown Assistance Call Handler, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and ensure that every driver receives help as quickly as possible. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed at all times.

This is a role with real impact: thanks to your calm approach, strong communication skills, and solution-oriented mindset, you truly make a difference during stressful situations. Your responsibilities: 

 
• Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing a breakdown on the road. 
 

 
• Analyze the problem by assessing the situation and gathering the necessary information. 
 

 
• Organize interventions and dispatch them to breakdown services, partners, or internal technicians. 
 

 
• Follow up on cases from A to Z, ensuring clear and continuous communication with the driver. 
 

 
• Register all relevant information in the system (time, location, nature of the problem, planning, etc.). 
 

 
• Remain calm in emergency situations and always act with a strong customer focus. 
 

 
• Work closely with a dedicated team that is available 24/7 to provide optimal customer support. 

What do we expect from you? 

 
• You have strong communication skills and are able to handle phone calls clearly, empathetically, and professionally. 
 

 
• You are stress-resistant and able to maintain an overview in busy and demanding situations. 
 
•  
Problem-solving comes naturally to you. 

 
•  
You are fluent in English and German (minimum B2 level) and another European Language. 

 
• You are comfortable working with digital tools and handling administrative follow-up. 
 
•  
You are willing to work flexible shifts: early, late, day and weekends — truck drivers are on the road anytime, anywhere. 

 
•  
Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside/mobility assistance is a plus, but not a requirement. 

 
• You hold a bachelor's degree or have relevant equivalent experience. 
 

 
• You have your own means of transportation.

jobs.description:

Our client is an international company located in Liege.

• Supervise and manage the accounts payable team to ensure smooth operations.
• Mentoring and training Junior Accountants to support their professional development and strengthen their technical accounting skills.
• Oversee invoice processing and payment approvals in compliance with company policies.
• Coordinate with internal departments and external vendors to resolve payment discrepancies.
• Maintain accurate records of all accounts payable transactions.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal controls.
• Prepare and review reports related to accounts payable performance.
• Support month-end and year-end closing processes as required.
• Propose process improvements to enhance efficiency in the accounts payable function.

A successful AP Team Leader Accountant should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Experience in accounts payable or similar financial operations roles.
• Strong organisational and team management skills.
• Proficiency in Excel.
• Knowledge of French and English.

• Valid EU work permit.

Service Technician 
 

Are you someone who enjoys solving technical problems and helping customers? Do you like working independently while also contributing ideas for improvements and new technical projects? Then this opportunity could be the right fit for you.
 

For a company based in the 
Roeselare region, we are looking for a Service Technician who enjoys a varied role. You will work in a technical environment where maintenance, installations, troubleshooting, and project work go hand in hand.
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 

• Diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical failures at customer sites. 

• Perform preventive maintenance on a variety of technical installations. 

• Assist with the installation and commissioning of new systems. 

• Contribute to technical improvements and new projects. 

• Act as a point of contact for customers and provide technical advice when needed.

• Mechanical and hydraulic installations. 

• Climate control and irrigation management systems. 

• Electrical installations, switchboards, cabling, and LED lighting systems.  

If you have an interest in design and engineering, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and optimization of electrical control panels.

• You enjoy combining hands-on technical work with problem-solving and analytical thinking.

For an international organization within the medical sector based in Ghent, we are looking for an experienced Accountant to support the financial management of the Belgian operations. In this varied role, you will take broad responsibility for a range of financial and accounting processes.

Your responsibilities:

• You will manage the full accounting cycle (A to Z) for the Belgian entity and its related holding structure.
• You will be responsible for both general and analytical accounting, ensuring the accuracy and quality of financial data.
• You will act as the main point of contact for accounting and financial matters within the organization.

Barman — Nando
 

Where Italian nostalgia meets real bar craft
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant — it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Barman to own our bar: someone who mixes with precision, keeps the bar running like clockwork during service, and makes every guest feel like they've pulled up a stool at Nonna's counter.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Prepare and serve drinks — cocktails, wine, coffee, aperitivo classics — accurately and efficiently 

• Welcome guests at the bar and set the tone for their evening 

• Keep the bar stocked, clean, and ready before service hits 

• Manage the pace of orders during busy periods without losing quality or friendliness 

• Coordinate with the floor team so drinks and food orders stay in sync 

• Handle guest requests and resolve minor issues with a calm, professional touch  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a barman/bartender in hospitality 

• Solid knowledge of classic cocktails, wine, and Italian aperitivo culture 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, hygiene- and detail-conscious 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €15.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real ownership of the bar from day one  

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

Air Cargo Belgium (ACB) is the official representative of the air cargo community at Brussels Airport Cargo. With over 
170 member companies, we bring together airlines, handlers, forwarders, the airport authority and other stakeholders. We connect, inspire, and 

strengthen the Brussels air cargo community through events, projects and communication.
 

Every year we organize several events that range from content-driven seminars with 20 participants, to bigger networking events like our BBQ with over 700 guests, to more leisurely events like a football tournament. Additionally, we also organize smaller activities like handing out Easter Eggs.
 

With our renewed strategy, we aim to grow from 
3,000 yearly event visitors/participants to over 7,000 in the coming years. This means more events, new ideas on how to best reach our audiences and more strong communication! To make this happen, we’re looking for a 

Community Engagement Coordinator to join our team.
 

Your Role:
As our new Community Engagement Coordinator, you will:
 

Events & Coordination
 
 

• Take the lead in event coordination from A to Z, including the planning, promotion and execution of workshops, seminars, networking events and larger community events. 

• Work closely with our Community Engagement Lead, another coordinator and the wider ACB team to ensure smooth event organization and execution. 

• Occasionally represent ACB, and support the community, at international fairs and events.  

Communication & Content
 
 

• Manage and grow ACB’s social media presence in collaboration with your community engagement colleagues, using tools such as Canva and scheduling tools to create engaging and professional content. 

• Create engaging content for newsletters, social media and online updates, highlighting community news, success stories and relevant information 

• Support the promotion and visibility of ACB’s initiatives, events and community activities.  

Community Engagement & Partnerships
 
 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with our member companies and act as a central point of contact for the community. 

• Contribute to and execute ACB’s community engagement strategy, tailored to the dynamics of the air cargo industry. 

• Gather feedback from community members and translate it into actionable recommendations to continuously improve our community engagement 

• Support the growth of memberships and sponsorships by attracting and engaging relevant stakeholders. 

• Identify and develop partnerships with relevant stakeholders to strengthen the visibility and impact of the ACB community. 

• Monitor engagement metrics and data and report on the results and impact of community engagement initiatives. 

• Act as a visible presence within the community by visiting members to share information, gather feedback, distribute materials and support campaigns or initiatives. 

Your Profile:
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Event Management or Marketing (or similar). 

• 3–5 years of relevant professional experience (preferred). 

• Excellent writing and communication skills in English (all external communication). 

• Good knowledge of Dutch (our internal team language). 

• Good knowledge of French, as the role involves direct contact with warehouse staff. 

• Hands-on experience with graphic design (e.g. designing posters with Canva or similar) and a good eye for visual communication. 

• Social media fluency and confidence in creating and managing engaging content across platforms. 

• A people-oriented personality: you enjoy meeting people, building relationships and making new contacts. 

• A proactive attitude: you take initiative, see what needs to be done and act on it. 

• A valid category B driving licence (required for driving a van/minibus for our events). 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Open to learning about aviation and air cargo and connecting with major players in the industry.  

A standard desk job isn’t enough for you — you love variety, dynamism and contact with people.

jobs.occupation: Production associate | With technical skills | Strombeek-Bever | ENG
jobs.description:
We are looking for a production associate for a leading international company in the consumer goods industry.

The company is located in Strombeek-Bever.

Your responsibilities:

 

 
• You prepare, set up, and operate pilot plant equipment for testing activities. 
 
• You perform assigned tests and experiments according to established procedures. 
 
• You reconfigure, adjust, and rebuild machine components when required. 
 
• You collect, retrieve, and accurately document test data. 
 
• You verify data quality and report any anomalies to your supervisor or technical coach. 
 
• You support administrative and reporting tasks related to testing activities. 
 
• You learn and apply new testing methods with a strong focus on quality and reliability. 
 
• You collaborate closely with engineers, scientists, and technical specialists. 

 
• You have a mechanical or electromechanical education or relevant experience. 
 
• You demonstrate strong hands-on technical skills. 
 
• You are comfortable working with machinery and equipment. 
 
• You maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. 
 
• You possess good computer skills and feel confident using software applications. 
 
• You communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken. 
 
• You show a proactive attitude and are willing to ask questions when needed. 
 
• You are comfortable with a role that can be physically demanding at times.

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
